observed.cause: The 0.22 m ball path contacts the broad 0.28 m tall tumbler too near its center of mass, transferring translation with negligible tipping torque.

decision: Retain as a valid negative calibration. Raise the physical lane and ball path and use a taller, narrower tumbler proxy so the Bullet contact acts above the center of mass; keep the six actuator variants and all bounded-motion gates.
